notes: masks: none recorded. Candidate animated elements found in source: the ASCII field behind the empty landing (AsciiWaveBackground.tsx redraws at 15 fps forever, PATTERN_DURATION 20 s), the sidebar working/unread status glyphs, the context/usage ring in the composer status row, the one-time What's-new popout (bottom-left, dismissed only by its X). Until the ASCII field is off or masked, A1 will hit the 5 s settle cap on an empty thread.
Popup and focus click unknown: Synara focuses the composer itself after a new thread (ChatView requestComposerFocus), so focusClick is null; the GUI must confirm the probe types without a click.

App auto-update: package.json uses electron-updater with app-update.yml owner Emanuele-web04/repo synara; main.js configureAutoUpdater() is called unconditionally and no settings key turns it off. reset cannot stop it; note it for Track F.

No app sign-in. Providers run the account's own claude/codex logins: providers.claudeAgent.homePath and providers.codex.homePath default to empty, which means ~/.claude and ~/.codex; reset.jsonKeys sets binaryPath to the system claude and codex (the app otherwise runs its bundled claude-agent-sdk 0.3.296 binary from app.asar.unpacked).

Synara stores state in ~/.synara (SYNARA_HOME overrides): userdata/state.sqlite, userdata/settings.json, userdata/keybindings.json, userdata/secrets, worktrees under ~/.synara/worktrees. The Electron userData is overridden to ~/Library/Application Support/synara (lowercase). reset moves both.

defaultThreadEnvMode is local in ServerSettings (packages/contracts/src/settings.ts and apps/web/src/appSettings.ts), so a thread runs in the project folder itself and waitDone cwd=worktree is right unless the GUI shows a worktree per thread.
Runtime mode factory default is full-access (apps/web/src/types.ts DEFAULT_RUNTIME_MODE) and interaction mode default (plan off), matching ADES.md 3.4; no permission step in configure.

Effort: Claude Opus 5.5's capability ladder marks high as the default (packages/contracts/src/model.ts CLAUDE_OPUS_5_CAPABILITIES), so configure.claude only picks the model. GPT-6 capabilities default to medium, so configure.codex presses model.effort.next once (Shift+Tab, keybindings.ts) to reach high; the GUI must confirm the footer reads High, and drop the step if the codex runtime catalog already defaults to high.

configure runs before openProject (profile.ts launch order), so the model picker is driven on the launch/home composer; a new draft is seeded from the sticky last-used selection (composerDraftModels.ts resolvePreferredComposerModelSelection), which is why this works.
openProject: sidebar.addProject is cmd+shift+o (apps/web/src/keybindings.ts) and opens Synara's own Create project dialog with a path field; the paste step assumes that field has focus.

timed.newThread is cmd+n (chat.new, keybindings.ts). longThread/shortThread are cmd+1/cmd+2 (thread.jump.N): the sidebar sorts by the latest user message (Sidebar.logic.ts getThreadSortTimestamp), descending, and created_at sort ignores attention-first, so the long thread built last is row 1 and a seed is row 2 as long as no later user message arrives in another thread.

Orchestration is built in: ClaudeAdapter.ts appends a Synara harness policy and four worker-<tier> subagent types (worker-low/medium/high/xhigh), and the gateway exposes synara_create_threads. No vendor command turns it on; the orchestrationTrigger line is an instruction, not a slash command, and the GUI should confirm subagents are available in a thread.
processNames: helper executables inside the bundle are Synara Helper, Synara Helper (Renderer), Synara Helper (GPU), Synara Helper (Plugin) and Contents/Helpers/synara-appsnap-helper.
